howto.name: Upload an image with a QR code
howto.text: JPG, PNG, WebP, or BMP. The QR code should be reasonably in-focus.

howto.name: PrivaTools decodes via pyzbar
howto.text: Detects the QR code anywhere in the image and at any angle. A damaged or partly covered code can still read when the damage stays within the code's built-in error correction, which tops out at about 30%.

howto.name: Read the decoded data
howto.text: Plain text, URL, vCard, WiFi credentials, or whatever the QR encoded.

faq.q: Can it read damaged QR codes?
faq.a: QR codes have built-in error correction (up to 30%). Slightly damaged codes still read; heavily damaged ones fail.

faq.q: Multiple QR codes in one image?
faq.a: All detected QR codes are returned with their position. Useful for batch scanning of labels.
pyzbar also reads Code 128, Code 39, EAN-13, UPC-A, etc. The decoder identifies the type automatically.
